pre_factor_gate.name: pre_factor_nonvacuous_hit_root_proxy
conditions: full materialized FFE surface has at least one selected root pair
selected public leaf has at least one known hit root before factorization

primary_root_policy.name: residue16_then_global_hash_cap1
primary_root_policy.train_rows: all preregistered pre-factor-gated surfaces through transfer index 87
primary_root_policy.policy_identity_selection_rule: selected before 112-119 from the 104-111 capped-family diagnostic: cap1 was the only tested residue16-then-global-hash cap with 2/2 preserving, zero false positives, and 2/2 below-rho scan/direct accounting
algorithm: rank candidate root hyperplanes using learned_target_zero_residue16_prior trained only on <=87 gated surfaces
if that candidate is not public-zero, continue with remaining candidates ordered by the static public global_root_hash key
stop at the first public-zero root hyperplane and charge all selector work plus root-scan or direct-root accounting

baseline_root_policies.name: summax_sage_low_constant_target_hash
baseline_root_policies.reason: frozen static public policy selected from <=87 rows; strongest non-posthoc baseline on 104-111

baseline_root_policies.name: global_root_hash
baseline_root_policies.reason: posthoc best static public control on 104-111; included only as a declared control for 112-119

baseline_root_policies.name: learned_target_zero_residue16_prior
baseline_root_policies.reason: uncapped learned policy that motivated the cap-and-fallback family

promotion_condition: After generating 112-119 strict signatures and pre-factor manifests, factor only gate-selected surfaces and score residue16_then_global_hash_cap1 trained only on <=87 gated surfaces. Count as positive only if preserving, false-positive-free, and below Pollard-rho under scan or direct-root accounting on every gate-selected surface. Report summax_sage_low_constant_target_hash, global_root_hash, and learned_target_zero_residue16_prior as preregistered controls.
